items.quote: This is the thing which the LORD commandeth, Fill an omer of it to be kept for your generations
items.claim: The LORD commanded the Israelites to preserve an omer of manna for future generations

items.quote: the bread wherewith I have fed you in the wilderness
items.claim: God provided bread (manna) to sustain the Israelites during their wilderness journey

items.quote: when I brought you forth from the land of Egypt
items.claim: God brought the Israelites forth from the land of Egypt
